subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary 130 The passage deals with our glorious war of independence. This war took place in 1971. The people who fought in this war and freed us from the occupation forces are called freedom fighters. A freedom fighter is honoured in all lands and in all times, because he fights for a noble cause which is the freedom of the motherland. The people from all walks of life took part in the war and finally we achieved our Bangladesh in 1971.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Jhenidah Govt. High School. Sl. No. 78; Page No. 126
